reopening_conditions: Pin one exact ONNX Runtime distribution and clear its redistribution terms.
Add a rights-cleared caller-owned ONNX graph with exact tensor metadata.
Implement the optional adapter behind an off-by-default build flag without changing installed v0 geometry or shared defaults.
Compare deterministic CPU outputs with an approved reference and record negative, malformed and missing-asset cases.
Measure the exact installed runtime on the target host before any availability or benchmark claim.
Complete provider intake and independent review before any public exposure.

rights_gap.consequence: No ONNX Runtime import, vendoring, linking, installed adapter, public provider or release claim is permitted until the exact runtime and any model asset are pinned and rights are cleared.

scope: Task-local synthetic documentation and exercise of the proposed developer-facing ONNX Runtime adapter boundary. No SDK adapter, public provider, ONNX Runtime import, real graph, weights, audio, device measurement or release claim is added.

session_requirements.note: These are declared requirements for a future adapter, not values queried from an installed runtime.

documented_constraints: ONNX Runtime is optional and guarded by AE_ENABLE_ONNXRUNTIME
a shared Ort::Env is created only when the optional runtime is enabled
model assets are resolved by logical id from prepare-time caller assets
missing asset lists and unknown model ids fail with AE_NOT_READY
no network, download or filesystem model lookup is performed in stages
source_identity.note: Source inspection is a boundary anchor only. No C++ stage is built, no ONNX session is created and no model weight is loaded.
